sentences.text: Respondent - State of Madhya Pradesh by Shri Rajwardhan  Government Advocate appearing on behalf of the Advocate Gener  ORDER
They are heard.
Perused the case diary / challan papers.

2] This is the applicant's first bail application filed under Section 483 of B.N.S.S., 2023 / Section 439 of Criminal Procedure Code,
1973 for grant of regular bail, as he / she is implicated in connection with Crime No.431 of 2021 registered at Police Station Balakwada, District Khargone (MP) for offence punishable under Sections 406, 420, 467, 468 and 471 of Indian Penal Code, 1860.
The applicant is in custody since 11.12.2025.
3] The allegation against the applicant is that he is involved in the alleged crime of criminal breach of trust and forgery with other co-accused persons.
4] Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant has been falsely implicated in this case and there is no direct link chain available against present applicant.

It is further submitted that name of the present applicant has also not been mentioned in the First Information Report (FIR)
and the FIR has been lodged against co-accused Aftab Khan and the applicant has been implicated on the basis of memorandum of co-accused which is not an admissible piece of evidence in the eyes of NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-IND:37999 2 MCRC-59852-2025 law and the applicant will cooperate in the trial and seizure from the applicant has already been done and there is no further interrogation of the applicant is required and this particular case is based on documentary evidence and no question will arose regarding tampering of witnesses.
It is further submitted that the applicant is in jail since 11.12.2025.
It is also submitted that the final conclusion of the trial is likely to take sufficient long time.
Hence, it is submitted that the bail application be allowed and he be released on bail.

sentences.text: 6] Having considered the rival submissions, perusal of the case diary and taking note of the fact that the case is based on documentary evidence and no question will arise regarding tampering of witnesses, this Court is inclined to allow the present application.
7] Accordingly, without commenting on the merits of the case, the application filed by the applicant is allowed.

The applicant is directed to be released on bail upon furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court for his/her regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he / she shall remain present before the court concerned during trial and shall also abide by the conditions enumerated under Section 437 (3) Criminal Procedure Code, 1973.
8] M.Cr.C. stands allowed and disposed of.
